column1: # voices.tsv — per-persona clip pitch and gain for Twelve Actors barks.
# Installed to data/twelveactors/voices.tsv. Optional: without this file each bot
# gets a pitch derived from a hash of its name (92..112), which is stable but
# arbitrary. This file is the curated version.
#   pitch  1..255, 100 = untouched. DoD:S has one male US voice and one male
#          German voice, so pitch is the only per-bot distinction available
#          without new audio assets. 92..112 is roughly two semitones either
#          way: audibly different, still a soldier.
#   gain   0.0..1.0, multiplies the bark before distance falloff. Optional,
#          defaults to 1.0. Use it to make one man quieter without moving him.
# Reload without restarting the server:  sm_ta_reload
# Names must match roster.tsv and the in-game bot names exactly (case
# insensitive). Anything not listed falls back to the name hash.
